name: Weather
description: The weather anywhere, kept current while the slide is up: now, the coming days, the 72-hour trend, the UV peak, sunrise and sunset. From Open-Meteo, which needs no key.
author: intrf4ce (from Kompas)

prompts.name: weather
prompts.description: The weather somewhere, on the stage
prompts.text: Put the weather for {args} on a slide, and tell me in a sentence or two what it is doing now and what the next few days look like.
prompts.default: where I am (my settings say, or ask me)
